executive-summary.problem: MinHash computation is bottleneck: 1.2μs per signature (single-threaded, AVX2 SIMD). Target: 10-30× compound speedup via CPU detection + cache optimization + batching.
executive-summary.solution: 3-Phase optimization roadmap: - Phase 1: CpuFeaturesCapsule (T1) - Runtime AVX-512/AVX2/SSE4.2/scalar dispatch (<10ns cached) - Phase 2: Cache-optimized SIMD (T2) - Memory transpose + prefetching (2-4× cache improvement) - Phase 3: BatchMinHashCapsule (T4+T1) - Thread-local batching, 50-100 docs (10-20× amortized)

speedup-targets.compound: 10-30× total (Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3, realistic B32 validation required)

q10.phase1: CpuFeaturesCapsule stores cached feature flags (AVX-512/AVX2/SSE4.2). AtomicU8 for lockfree cached lookup (<10ns vs ~1ms cpuid). DualAtomicU64 pattern NOT needed (single atomic sufficient).
q10.phase2: MinHashSignatureCapsule already SIMD (f32x8 AVX2, 7.1× validated). Optimize: Memory layout transpose (SoA not AoS) + prefetching. Target: 2-4× cache improvement (reduce cache misses).
q10.phase3: Thread-local batch buffer (50-100 docs) amortizes hash overhead. Atomic coordination for batch submission (zero contention). Target: 10-20× amortized speedup (batch size dependent).

q11.answer: Rust transforms via safe SIMD + zero-cost atomics
q11.rust-advantage: - portable_simd: Cross-platform f32x16 (AVX-512), f32x8 (AVX2), f32x4 (SSE4.2) - AtomicU8: Lockfree CPU capability caching (zero unsafe) - Type safety: Impossible to mix scalar/SIMD paths at compile-time - Cache alignment: #[repr(C, align(64))] enforced at compile-time

nightly-features.feature: AVX-512 doubles parallelism: 16 lanes vs 8 lanes (2× theoretical). Requires nightly + AVX-512 CPU (Intel Xeon Scalable, AMD EPYC Zen 4+). Feature flag: avx512-minhash (optional, fallback to AVX2).
Explicit prefetch instructions for Zen 3+ prefetcher optimization. Reduces cache miss penalty (200-300 cycles → 0 cycles). Feature flag: cache-optimized-minhash (optional, stable fallback exists).
Pre-compute hash seeds at compile-time (0ns runtime cost). Not critical for MinHash (seeds generated once at construction).

problem-analysis.current-layout: MinHashSignatureCapsule stores 128 hashes as Array-of-Structures (AoS). Cache misses during SIMD load: Each f32x8 load spans 2+ cache lines. Prefetcher ineffective: Non-contiguous memory access pattern.
problem-analysis.bottleneck: Cache miss penalty: 200-300 cycles per miss. Expected: 10-20 cache misses per 128-hash signature. Total penalty: 2000-6000 cycles (~1-3μs @ 2GHz).
problem-analysis.opportunity: Transpose to Structure-of-Arrays (SoA): Hashes in contiguous memory. Prefetch next cache line: Reduce miss penalty to 0 cycles. Target: 2-4× cache improvement (reduce cache misses by 50-75%).

problem-analysis.current-approach: Process documents one-at-a-time: compute_signature() per document. Overhead: Function call + SIMD setup + teardown per doc. Opportunity: Batch 50-100 docs to amortize overhead.
problem-analysis.bottleneck: Per-document overhead: ~50ns (function call, SIMD init). For 100 docs: 50ns × 100 = 5μs wasted overhead. Batching: Amortize 5μs across 100 docs = 50ns total.
problem-analysis.opportunity: Thread-local batch buffer: Accumulate 50-100 docs before processing. Atomic coordination: Submit batch when full (zero contention). Target: 10-20× amortized speedup (batch size dependent).
